e.title: **新加坡 MAS 金融机构名录（Financial Institutions Directory）**（`eservices.mas.gov.sg/fid`）：⭐ 站点标题逐字为「**Financial Institutions Directory**」——⭐ 它的检索下拉**按牌照类型列出整套分类并带实时计数**，保险侧逐字为：**Direct Insurer (Life) 16 / Direct Insurer (General) 52 / Direct Insurer (Composite) 9 / Reinsurer (Life) 2 / Reinsurer (General) 22 / Reinsurer (Composite) 9 / Captive Insurer (Life) 1 / Captive Insurer (General) 78 / Captive Insurer (Composite) 7 / Lloyd’s Asia Scheme 19 / Authorised Reinsurer (General) 4 / Authorised Reinsurer (Life) 1 / Authorised Reinsurer (Composite) 3 / Registered Insurance Broker 111 / Exempt Insurance Broker 49 / Representative Office (Insurance) 2 / Financial Holding Company (Insurance) 2 / Approved Insurance Broker 1**；⭐ 站点自述用途是**核对机构官方联络方式**（逐字：**If in doubt, check its official contact details on its website and the MAS Financial Institutions Directory.**）。
e.summary: **新加坡金融管理局（MAS）的金融机构名录**：本条补的是**「东南亚侧的持牌名单面」**，也是本组四条里**唯一把「牌照类型 + 计数」直接摊在检索入口上**的一条。保险相关**18 类**逐字列出（寿险/产险/综合自保/再保/专属自保/劳合社亚洲计划/授权再保/持牌与豁免经纪/代表处/保险控股/核准经纪），其中 **Captive Insurer (General) 78** 与 **Registered Insurance Broker 111** 是两类数量最大的主体。五大板块为 **Banking / Capital Markets / Financial Advisory / Insurance / Payments**。本次实测 **HTTP 200 / 84,015 字节**，清洗后可见正文 **3,026 字符**。⚠️ **计数为抓取当刻的前端渲染值**，本条目按 **18 类相加 = 388** 自行求和，**并标注这是本条目的算术**。
e.body:
**新加坡金融管理局（MAS，Monetary Authority of Singapore）的 Financial Institutions Directory**（`eservices.mas.gov.sg/fid`）是**新加坡持牌金融机构的公开名录**。⭐ 本条补的是**登记册面里的东南亚一侧**，也是本组四条中**形态最不一样的一条**：它不是「一页名单」，而是**一个按牌照类型切分的检索入口**，并且**把每类的主体数量直接写在分类项后面**。对做**市场结构速览**的人，这一页等于**一张带计数的持牌主体清单**。
**保险侧逐字实测（18 类，含计数）**：**Direct Insurer (Life) 16**、**Direct Insurer (General) 52**、**Direct Insurer (Composite) 9**、**Reinsurer (Life) 2**、**Reinsurer (General) 22**、**Reinsurer (Composite) 9**、**Captive Insurer (Life) 1**、**Captive Insurer (General) 78**、**Captive Insurer (Composite) 7**、**Lloyd’s Asia Scheme 19**、**Authorised Reinsurer (General) 4**、**Authorised Reinsurer (Life) 1**、**Authorised Reinsurer (Composite) 3**、**Registered Insurance Broker 111**、**Exempt Insurance Broker 49**、**Representative Office (Insurance) 2**、**Financial Holding Company (Insurance) 2**、**Approved Insurance Broker 1**。⚠️ **把 18 类相加得 388**——**这是本条目自己的算术**（抓取当刻的分类计数之和），**不是站点给出的合计数**；站点未声明该口径是否等于「保险主体总数」（同一集团可能出现在多个类型下）。
⭐ **分类本身透露的三个结构特征**：① **专属自保（Captive）被细分到 Life / General / Composite 三类且数量可观**（General 78），说明**自保在新加坡是有实际体量的业态**，而不是边角；② **再保险同时存在两套口径**——**Reinsurer（再保人）**与**Authorised Reinsurer（获授权再保人）**，各自又分 Life／General／Composite；③ **经纪侧区分 Registered（111）与 Exempt（49）**，另有 **Approved Insurance Broker 1**，**三种身份的差别本次未取原文**（见未核实项）。
**其他板块的同页计数**（同一抓取、同一口径）：**Banking** 含 **Local Bank 6**、**Qualifying Full Bank 10**、**Full Bank 20**、**Wholesale Bank 95**、**Merchant Bank 21**、**Finance Company 3**、**Representative Office (Banking) 27**、**Financial Holding Company (Banking) 1**、**SGS Primary Dealer 12**；**Capital Markets** 含 **Capital Markets Services Licensee 1579**、**Licensed Trust Company 67**、**Approved Exchange 4**、**Recognised Market Operator 79**；**Financial Advisory** 含 **Licensed Financial Adviser 71**、**Exempt Financial Adviser 574**；**Payments** 含 **Money-changing Licensee 230**、**Major Payment Institution 244**、**Standard Payment Institution 13**。⭐ 一眼可见**「持牌」与「豁免」成对出现**（Exempt Insurance Broker、Exempt Financial Adviser、Exempt Capital Markets Services Entity、Exempt Trust Company）——**「豁免」不等于「不在册」**，这是读新加坡名录时最容易踩的坑。
**站点的自述用途**值得单独记：页面上写「**If in doubt, check its official contact details on its website and the MAS Financial Institutions Directory.**」，并配政府网站识别提示「**Official website links end with .gov.sg**」。⭐ 即**MAS 把这份名录定位成「防假冒」工具**：**先查名录，再按名录上的联络方式联系**。对做**消费者保护**或**反诈骗**研究的人，这是一个可直接引用的制度设计表述。
**对 RIAA 学生的用法**：① 查**某家新加坡保险／经纪机构是否持牌**及**持的是哪一类牌**；② 用分类计数做**市场结构速览**（例如自保与再保的相对体量）；③ 与 [[apra-registers]]、[[japan-fsa-licensed-operators]]、[[eiopa-registers]] 并读，比较**四种名录的切分口径**（澳洲按险种分册、日本按业态分区、新加坡按牌照类型带计数、欧洲按登记册）；④ 与 [[mas-insurance-statistics]] 配合：**统计给行业数字，名录给主体身份**。
**窗口状况（2026-09-30）**：`https://eservices.mas.gov.sg/fid` 实测 **HTTP 200 / 84,015 字节**，`content-type: text/html; charset=utf-8`，站点标题逐字「**Financial Institutions Directory**」，清洗后可见正文 **3,026 字符**（insur 18 次、licen 9 次命中）。⚠️ **未核实项**：① **计数为前端渲染值**，本条目**未通过逐类检索复核**；② 名录的**更新时间戳**未取；③ **Registered／Exempt／Approved Insurance Broker 三者的法律差别**未取原文；④ **Captive Insurer 三类**的定义与监管差异未取；⑤ 是否提供**批量下载或 API** 未验证。
e.verified_note: **窗口状况（2026-09-30）**：`https://eservices.mas.gov.sg/fid` 返回 **HTTP 200 / 84,015 字节**，`content-type: text/html; charset=utf-8`，站点标题逐字「**Financial Institutions Directory**」；清洗后可见正文 **3,026 字符**（insur 18 次、licen 9 次、authoris 3 次命中）；同日服务器 `date:` 头与本机 **2026-09-30** 一致。⚠️ **未核实**：① **分类计数是页面前端渲染出来的数字**，本条目**只做了一次抓取、未逐类发起检索复核**——故这些数字**应视为「抓取当刻的页面显示值」**；② **18 类相加 = 388 是本条目自己的算术**，**不是站点声明**，且站点未说明该口径是否等于主体总数（同一集团可能同时出现在多个类型下）；③ 名录的**更新时间戳**未取；④ **Registered／Exempt／Approved Insurance Broker 三者的法律差别**未取原文，本条目只照抄类型名与计数；⑤ **Captive Insurer 三类**的定义未取；⑥ 是否提供**批量下载或 API** 未验证。
e.title_en: **MAS Financial Institutions Directory (Singapore)** at `eservices.mas.gov.sg/fid`: ⭐ the site title is, verbatim, **Financial Institutions Directory** — ⭐ its search dropdown **lists the whole licence taxonomy with live counts**, and on the insurance side, verbatim: **Direct Insurer (Life) 16 / Direct Insurer (General) 52 / Direct Insurer (Composite) 9 / Reinsurer (Life) 2 / Reinsurer (General) 22 / Reinsurer (Composite) 9 / Captive Insurer (Life) 1 / Captive Insurer (General) 78 / Captive Insurer (Composite) 7 / Lloyd’s Asia Scheme 19 / Authorised Reinsurer (General) 4 / Authorised Reinsurer (Life) 1 / Authorised Reinsurer (Composite) 3 / Registered Insurance Broker 111 / Exempt Insurance Broker 49 / Representative Office (Insurance) 2 / Financial Holding Company (Insurance) 2 / Approved Insurance Broker 1**; ⭐ the site states its own purpose as **verifying official contact details** (verbatim: **If in doubt, check its official contact details on its website and the MAS Financial Institutions Directory.**).
e.title_hk: **新加坡 MAS 金融機構名錄（Financial Institutions Directory）**（`eservices.mas.gov.sg/fid`）：⭐ 站點標題逐字為「**Financial Institutions Directory**」——⭐ 檢索下拉**按牌照類型列出整套分類並帶實時計數**，保險側逐字為：**Direct Insurer (Life) 16 / Direct Insurer (General) 52 / Direct Insurer (Composite) 9 / Reinsurer (Life) 2 / Reinsurer (General) 22 / Reinsurer (Composite) 9 / Captive Insurer (Life) 1 / Captive Insurer (General) 78 / Captive Insurer (Composite) 7 / Lloyd’s Asia Scheme 19 / Authorised Reinsurer (General) 4 / Authorised Reinsurer (Life) 1 / Authorised Reinsurer (Composite) 3 / Registered Insurance Broker 111 / Exempt Insurance Broker 49 / Representative Office (Insurance) 2 / Financial Holding Company (Insurance) 2 / Approved Insurance Broker 1**；⭐ 站點自述用途係**核對機構官方聯絡方式**。
e.summary_en: **The Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) Financial Institutions Directory**: this entry adds **the licensed-list surface for Southeast Asia**, and it is the only one of this batch that **puts licence type and count directly on the search entry**. Eighteen insurance-related types are listed verbatim (direct life, general and composite insurers; life, general and composite reinsurers; three captive classes; the **Lloyd’s Asia Scheme**; authorised reinsurers; registered and exempt brokers; a representative office; an insurance financial holding company; an approved broker), with **Captive Insurer (General) 78** and **Registered Insurance Broker 111** as the two largest groups. The five blocks are **Banking / Capital Markets / Financial Advisory / Insurance / Payments**. Measured this round: **HTTP 200 / 84,015 bytes**, **3,026 visible characters** after cleaning. ⚠️ **The counts are front-end values at fetch time**; this entry sums the 18 classes to **388** and **labels that sum as its own arithmetic**.
e.summary_hk: **新加坡金融管理局（MAS）嘅金融機構名錄**：本條補嘅係**東南亞側嘅持牌名單面**，亦係本組四條中**唯一將「牌照類型 + 計數」直接攤喺檢索入口**嘅一條。保險相關**18 類**逐字列出（壽險/產險/綜合自保/再保/專屬自保/勞合社亞洲計劃/授權再保/持牌與豁免經紀/代表處/保險控股/核准經紀），其中 **Captive Insurer (General) 78** 同 **Registered Insurance Broker 111** 係兩類數量最大嘅主體。五大板塊為 **Banking / Capital Markets / Financial Advisory / Insurance / Payments**。本次實測 **HTTP 200 / 84,015 字節**，清洗後可見正文 **3,026 字符**。⚠️ **計數為抓取當刻前端渲染值**，本條按 **18 類相加 = 388** 自行求和並**標註係本條目算術**。
e.body_en:
**The Financial Institutions Directory of the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS)** at `eservices.mas.gov.sg/fid` is **the public directory of licensed financial institutions in Singapore**. ⭐ This entry adds **the Southeast Asian side of the register surface**, and it is the **most unusual shape in this batch**: rather than a single list page it is **a search entry point partitioned by licence type**, and it **prints the number of entities in each class right beside the class name**. For a quick read of market structure, that makes the page **a licensed-entity inventory with counts**.
**Insurance side, measured verbatim (18 classes with counts)**: **Direct Insurer (Life) 16**, **Direct Insurer (General) 52**, **Direct Insurer (Composite) 9**, **Reinsurer (Life) 2**, **Reinsurer (General) 22**, **Reinsurer (Composite) 9**, **Captive Insurer (Life) 1**, **Captive Insurer (General) 78**, **Captive Insurer (Composite) 7**, **Lloyd’s Asia Scheme 19**, **Authorised Reinsurer (General) 4**, **Authorised Reinsurer (Life) 1**, **Authorised Reinsurer (Composite) 3**, **Registered Insurance Broker 111**, **Exempt Insurance Broker 49**, **Representative Office (Insurance) 2**, **Financial Holding Company (Insurance) 2**, **Approved Insurance Broker 1**. ⚠️ **Summing the 18 classes gives 388** — **that is this entry’s own arithmetic** on the counts as displayed at fetch time; **the site states no total**, and whether this equals the number of distinct insurance entities is unstated (one group can appear under several licence types).
⭐ **The taxonomy itself exposes three structural features.** (1) **Captives are split into life, general and composite and are numerically material** (general 78), so **captive insurance is a real line of business in Singapore**, not a footnote. (2) **Two reinsurance families coexist** — **Reinsurer** and **Authorised Reinsurer** — each again life, general and composite. (3) On the broking side, **Registered (111) and Exempt (49)** are separated, with one **Approved Insurance Broker**; **the legal differences between those three statuses were not retrieved** (see the not-verified list).
**Counts in the other blocks on the same page and fetch**: **Banking** includes **Local Bank 6**, **Qualifying Full Bank 10**, **Full Bank 20**, **Wholesale Bank 95**, **Merchant Bank 21**, **Finance Company 3**, **Representative Office (Banking) 27**, **Financial Holding Company (Banking) 1** and **SGS Primary Dealer 12**; **Capital Markets** includes **Capital Markets Services Licensee 1579**, **Licensed Trust Company 67**, **Approved Exchange 4** and **Recognised Market Operator 79**; **Financial Advisory** includes **Licensed Financial Adviser 71** and **Exempt Financial Adviser 574**; **Payments** includes **Money-changing Licensee 230**, **Major Payment Institution 244** and **Standard Payment Institution 13**. ⭐ Note how often **licensed and exempt appear in pairs** (Exempt Insurance Broker, Exempt Financial Adviser, Exempt Capital Markets Services Entity, Exempt Trust Company): **exempt does not mean absent from the register**, which is the easiest trap when reading Singapore lists.
**The stated purpose is worth recording separately**: the page says, verbatim, **If in doubt, check its official contact details on its website and the MAS Financial Institutions Directory.**, alongside the government-site notice **Official website links end with .gov.sg**. ⭐ MAS positions this directory as an **anti-impersonation tool**: **check the directory first, then use the contact details it gives**. For work on consumer protection or scam prevention that is a directly citable design statement.
**How an RIAA student can use it.** (1) Check **whether a Singapore insurer or intermediary is licensed and under which licence type**. (2) Use the class counts for a **market-structure snapshot** (for example the relative weight of captives and reinsurers). (3) Read it with [[apra-registers]], [[japan-fsa-licensed-operators]] and [[eiopa-registers]] to compare **four ways of carving up a register** (Australia by class of business, Japan by business category, Singapore by licence type with counts, Europe by individual register). (4) Pair it with [[mas-insurance-statistics]]: **statistics give industry numbers, the directory gives entity identity**.
**Window status (2026-09-30)**: `https://eservices.mas.gov.sg/fid` returned **HTTP 200 / 84,015 bytes**, `content-type: text/html; charset=utf-8`, site title verbatim **Financial Institutions Directory**, with **3,026 visible characters** after cleaning (18 hits of insur, 9 of licen). ⚠️ **Not verified**: (1) the **counts are front-end rendered values** and were **not re-checked class by class through the search**; (2) the directory **timestamp**; (3) the **legal distinction between Registered, Exempt and Approved Insurance Broker**; (4) the definitions and supervisory differences of the **three captive classes**; (5) whether **bulk download or an API** exists.
e.body_hk:
**新加坡金融管理局（MAS）嘅 Financial Institutions Directory**（`eservices.mas.gov.sg/fid`）係**新加坡持牌金融機構嘅公開名錄**。⭐ 本條補嘅係**登記冊面嘅東南亞一側**，亦係本組四條中**形態最唔同嘅一條**：佢唔係「一頁名單」，而係**按牌照類型切分嘅檢索入口**，並且**將每類主體數量直接寫喺分類項後面**。對做**市場結構速覽**嘅人，呢一頁等於**一張帶計數嘅持牌主體清單**。
**保險側逐字實測（18 類，含計數）**：**Direct Insurer (Life) 16**、**Direct Insurer (General) 52**、**Direct Insurer (Composite) 9**、**Reinsurer (Life) 2**、**Reinsurer (General) 22**、**Reinsurer (Composite) 9**、**Captive Insurer (Life) 1**、**Captive Insurer (General) 78**、**Captive Insurer (Composite) 7**、**Lloyd’s Asia Scheme 19**、**Authorised Reinsurer (General) 4**、**Authorised Reinsurer (Life) 1**、**Authorised Reinsurer (Composite) 3**、**Registered Insurance Broker 111**、**Exempt Insurance Broker 49**、**Representative Office (Insurance) 2**、**Financial Holding Company (Insurance) 2**、**Approved Insurance Broker 1**。⚠️ **18 類相加 = 388 係本條目自己嘅算術**，**唔係站點聲明**。
⭐ **分類本身透露三個結構特徵**：① **專屬自保（Captive）細分到 Life / General / Composite 且數量可觀**（General 78），說明**自保喺新加坡係有實際體量嘅業態**；② **再保險同時存在兩套口徑**——**Reinsurer** 同 **Authorised Reinsurer**；③ **經紀側區分 Registered（111）同 Exempt（49）**，另有 **Approved Insurance Broker 1**，**三者差別本次未取原文**。
**站點自述用途**值得單獨記：頁面寫「**If in doubt, check its official contact details on its website and the MAS Financial Institutions Directory.**」，並配政府網站識別提示「**Official website links end with .gov.sg**」。⭐ 即**MAS 將呢份名錄定位成「防假冒」工具**：**先查名錄，再按名錄上嘅聯絡方式聯繫**。
**對 RIAA 學生嘅用法**：① 查**某間新加坡保險／經紀機構係否持牌**及**持邊一類牌**；② 用分類計數做**市場結構速覽**；③ 同 [[apra-registers]]、[[japan-fsa-licensed-operators]]、[[eiopa-registers]] 並讀，比較**四種名錄嘅切分口徑**；④ 同 [[mas-insurance-statistics]] 配合：**統計俾行業數字，名錄俾主體身份**。
**窗口狀況（2026-09-30）**：`https://eservices.mas.gov.sg/fid` 實測 **HTTP 200 / 84,015 字節**，站點標題逐字「**Financial Institutions Directory**」，清洗後可見正文 **3,026 字符**。⚠️ **未核實項**：① **計數為前端渲染值**，**未逐類檢索覆核**；② 名錄**更新時間戳**未取；③ **Registered／Exempt／Approved Insurance Broker 三者法律差別**未取原文；④ **Captive Insurer 三類**定義未取；⑤ 是否提供**批量下載或 API** 未驗證。
